sources.content: # CLAUDE.md for Pomberly. Pomberly provisions and retires build runner machines in a server rack. The control service is Python 3.12 managed with uv. Install dependencies with `uv sync`, start the service locally with `uv run pomberly serve`, and run tests with `uv run pytest`. The local service listens on port 8640. Database migrations live in `migrations/` and use Alembic; create one with `uv run alembic revision -m "<summary>"`. Lint the code with `uv run ruff check` before every commit.

Rules. Never call the power control API in tests; use the fake in `tests/fakes/power.py`. Any change to `pomberly/retire.py` needs a second reviewer, because a bug there can wipe a live machine. Type hints are required on every function, and `uv run mypy pomberly` must pass with no errors. Keep functions under 60 lines. Secrets come from environment variables that start with POMBERLY_, never from files in the repository. Log through the standard logging module, never with print.

claims.text: The Pomberly control service runs on Python 3.11.
Changes to `pomberly/retire.py` need a second reviewer.
Pomberly tests use a fake power controller in `tests/fakes/power.py`.
Type hints are optional on Pomberly functions.
The local Pomberly service listens on port 8640.
